run_point_sup_training: run the point supervision training script with a config file and optional command line arguments
run_eval_only: run evaluation only mode to test a model on a dataset using the Trainer class
build_train_loader: build a training data loader with optional point supervision dataset mapper for detection tasks
build_evaluator: build a COCO evaluator for a given dataset name and output folder using the Trainer class
setup_config: setup and merge configuration from a file with point rend and point sup config options
